text:
ella_sales: FYI: Zenith POC flagged an unexpected drop in their free sandbox balance. They started with 15k tokens, now ~9k after a morning of search/re-rank testing.
finn_support: do we have their account id and any client logs?
ella_sales: acct-ZEN-42. They say they were running an embeddings->rerank pipeline against 1k docs in parallel.
kai_eng: embeddings + rerank can be noisy if they call rerank per document. ask for the request pattern/snippet.
mira_se: @kai_eng they also flagged that the POC is blocked by a security questionnaire (SOC2 + data residency) but they want billing clarity before signing.
ella_sales: client sent a snippet: 
```js
const ids = docs.map(d => model.embed(d.text))
ids.forEach(id => {
  const score = model.rerank({query, candidate: id})
})
```

finn_support: that loop is bad for batching. they'll get charged for 1000 embed calls + 1000 rerank calls. recommend `batchEmbed` + `rerankBatch`.
infra_bot: billing-alert acct-ZEN-42: free_credit_threshold=10000 crossed; notify=team-sales,billing.
taylor_billing: pulling meter rows for acct-ZEN-42 between 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z-2026-03-22T10:00:00Z:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:02Z acct-ZEN-42 meter embedding tokens=4200 model=embed-xl
2026-03-22T09:12:03Z acct-ZEN-42 meter rerank tokens=3500 model=rw-rank
2026-03-22T09:15:10Z acct-ZEN-42 meter embedding tokens=2100 model=embed-xl
```

kai_eng: that aligns — repeated embed + rerank bursts. also looks like they were parallelizing 50 concurrent workers which amplified rate usage. do we show any rate-limit 429s?
infra_bot: infra-log acct-ZEN-42: 2026-03-22T09:12:03Z status=429 reqs=48 window=60s
mira_se: they were testing P95 latency and spun up a concurrency test. they didn't implement client-side backoff; their test harness retried immediately on 429s.
finn_support: double burn from retries + per-doc rerank explains the ~6k drop. client asked if tokens used by `rerank` are charged the same as generation. we should confirm pricing and show unit accounting.
taylor_billing: rerank is billed per token for the candidate + query context; embeddings billed per input. i can export itemized accounting CSV and share.
ella_sales: client wants an immediate adjustment/credit for accidental overage — they say they were in 'trial mode' and expected sandbox protections.
taylor_billing: policy: for sandbox/trial, if it's customer-side config causing overusage, we usually educate. but we can offer a one-time good-faith credit while they fix their harness. propose provisional credit = 6k tokens.
mira_se: also they requested official SOC2 doc and a short note we won't share their data. that delay is blocking enterprise legal sign-off. can security spin out SOC2 access request?
kai_eng: created INF-1302 to look at client patterns and add a metering heuristic to flag per-doc rerank loops for trial accounts. will also add a best-practice note to docs.
finn_support: action items: 1) send code sample recommending `batchEmbed` + `rerankBatch` and backoff; 2) taylor to post provisional 6k credit; 3) kai to evaluate INF-1302 for metering guardrail.
ella_sales: client wants timeline — can we give ETA for the metering guardrail and the credit reconciliation?
taylor_billing: provisional credit posted now (6k tokens). final reconciliation pending infra backfill + INF-1302 RCA.
kai_eng: guardrail spike detection prototype ETA 72h, deploy 5d if approved. backfill/refund job ETA 7d.
mira_se: security will share SOC2 summary and a contact for the legal team by EOD.
ella_sales: thanks team. I'll tell Zenith we issued a provisional credit and we have a plan to prevent recurrence. please cc me on the docs + how-to. :white_check_mark:
finn_support: sending the how-to + safe client snippet now.
infra_bot: ticket INF-1302 created and linked to acct-ZEN-42.
